summary: Charles & Colvard Ltd. (the Company) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an acquisition/disposition of assets under the JDP Purchase Agreement. The Company sold substantially all of its assets to Van Lang Jewelry LLC / Jewelry Design Partners LLC (JDP) for $1.5M, subject to a credit bid against DIP facility indebtedness. The transaction occurred under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code, with JDP as stalking horse bidder and creditor. A former director, Duc Pham, is JDP manager. The auction concluded on June 22, 2026, leading to the sale. Watch for final court approval and potential competing bids; the credit-bid structure limits cash proceeds.
